name: anomaly detection results and top anomalies
description: The stock Anomaly Detection plugin after historical analysis has written result documents: result search, per-detector result routes, `_topAnomalies` (orders, sizes, category fields, errors), profile of every type, tasks, preview and validate of category detectors, stats and delete. Generated ids are placeholders.
setup: index compat-adr-src: 600 minutes from epoch ms 1700000000000, two documents a minute (host h0 and h1, city c0..c2 rotating), v a sine around 10, host h0 spiking by 30 at minutes 400 to 403 and host h1 at minute 500
placeholders: `{label}` in a request is the value the step that captured it received; `<label>` in a response is where that value appeared. `<volatile>` is a time, a counter or a generated value that differs on every run.
